Computes 2024 and 2025 code violation counts per tract from observations, joins population denominators, calculates per-1000-resident rates for each year, then ranks tracts by the absolute rate increase (2025 minus 2024) descending, with tract name as tiebreaker.
sql:
WITH yearly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.geoid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.year = 2024 THEN o.value ELSE 0 END) AS code_violations_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.year = 2025 THEN o.value ELSE 0 END) AS code_violations_2025
  FROM fw_pg.tract_observations o
  WHERE o.run_id = 'r_20261026_5b7c97'
    AND o.source = 'm1_city_v2'
    AND o.geoid IS NOT NULL
    AND o.value_kind = 'count'
  GROUP BY o.geoid
),
	rates AS (
  SELECT
    t.geoid,
    t.name AS tract_name,
    y.code_violations_2024,
    y.code_violations_2025,
    CAST(y.code_violations_2025 AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(p.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE), 0) AS rate_2025_per_1000,
    CAST(y.code_violations_2024 AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(p.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE), 0) AS rate_2024_per_1000,
    CAST(p.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN yearly_counts y ON t.geoid = y.geoid
  LEFT JOIN session.fw_5b7c97_population_cdc_v2 p ON p.tractfips = t.geoid
)
SELECT
  tract_name,
  (rate_2025_per_1000 - rate_2024_per_1000) AS code_violation_rate_increase_per_1000,
  rate_2024_per_1000,
  rate_2025_per_1000,
  code_violations_2024,
  code_violations_2025,
  totalpopulation
FROM rates
ORDER BY code_violation_rate_increase_per_1000 DESC, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200

Computes 2024 and 2025 code violation counts per tract from observations, joins to CDC PLACES total population per tract, calculates rates per 1,000 residents for each year, then returns the year-over-year rate increase sorted descending, with raw counts and population denominator for transparency.
sql:
WITH yearly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.geoid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.year = 2024 THEN o.value ELSE 0 END) AS code_violations_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.year = 2025 THEN o.value ELSE 0 END) AS code_violations_2025
  FROM fw_pg.tract_observations o
  WHERE o.run_id = 'r_20261026_5b7c97'
    AND o.source = 'm1_city_v2'
    AND o.geoid IS NOT NULL
    AND o.value_kind = 'count'
  GROUP BY o.geoid
),
rates AS (
  SELECT
    t.geoid,
    t.name AS tract_name,
    y.code_violations_2024,
    y.code_violations_2025,
    CAST(y.code_violations_2025 AS DOUBLE) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(CAST(p.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE), 0) AS rate_2025_per_1000,
    CAST(y.code_violations_2024 AS DOUBLE) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(CAST(p.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE), 0) AS rate_2024_per_1000,
    CAST(p.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN yearly_counts y ON t.geoid = y.geoid
  LEFT JOIN session.fw_5b7c97_population_cdc_v2 p ON p.tractfips = t.geoid
)
SELECT
  tract_name,
  (rate_2025_per_1000 - rate_2024_per_1000) AS code_violation_rate_increase_per_1000,
  rate_2024_per_1000,
  rate_2025_per_1000,
  code_violations_2024,
  code_violations_2025,
  totalpopulation
FROM rates
ORDER BY code_violation_rate_increase_per_1000 DESC, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200
